title: Astra 6 Pro CAD
body:
I used Astra 6 Pro to build an ornate bench from an image reference. The result includes a CAD assembly with 32 separate parts, an editable Blender scene, and a textured GLB.

This video uses the CAD parts. They separate, rotate, and reassemble over 20 seconds.

The dimensions and hidden construction are inferred from the reference.

videos.caption: The 32 CAD parts separate, rotate, and reassemble.
